results.title: MyExpatTaxes Launches Stand-Alone FBAR for US Expats
results.snippet: Now, MyExpatTaxes expands the opportunity to Americans who may not be required to file a US Tax Return or who have filed their US Tax Return by another means to file their FBAR via MyExpatFBAR. The price for standalone FBAR filing with MyExpatTaxes new product, MyExpatFBAR, is €49 per FBAR.

results.title: Expat Taxes Made Simple: MyExpatTaxes vs Expatfile
results.snippet: Both providers charge an additional fee for FBAR. For expats with more complex needs, MyExpatTaxes’ Base (Investor/Small Business) Plan costs $175 and includes FBAR at no extra cost.
